entangling_channel.assumption_boundary: no direct matter-matter quantum channel and only local operations plus classical communication

polarization_rank_gate.gate: never force a six-mode classification when the realized antenna matrix is rank deficient

known_blockers: no public gravity-mediated entanglement response exists
exact reusable time-stream payloads for source-modulated memory tests are not bound
higher-cumulant searches require detector nonstationarity and glitch controls
Q12 requires a covariant source-plus-memory-plus-bath completion before fundamental interpretation
Q13 lacks an energy-conserving capture/release vertex and preferred-frame resolution

next_falsifiers.test: one frozen multi-event dispersion and network-polarization transfer with rank-deficient events retained
score every published energy bin for a frozen smearing-radius grid with the published background model

next_falsifiers.source: source-modulated atom interferometer or torsion-balance time streams
next_falsifiers.test: same frozen kernel must predict phase lag, source-off ringdown, autocovariance, and finite-occupation cumulants

data_readiness.0: protocol only; no gravity-sensitive response exists
data_readiness.1: primary paper exists but exact reusable response rows are not identified
data_readiness.2: public source or supplement is identified; exact payload hashes are not receipted
data_readiness.3: exact public dataset family and unchanged test are specified; observational payload remains unopened
data_readiness.4: local source receipt exists and the frozen test may run

novelty.2: new executable comparison or combination may be useful; literature boundary incomplete
novelty.3: specific synthesis appears uncommon and merits a dedicated novelty audit
novelty.4: reserved; requires completed historical and current novelty audit

score_contract.rule: Axes are reported separately. They are not added, averaged, multiplied, or used as a probability of truth.

theory_health.0: known fatal conflict in the stated unrestricted form
theory_health.2: effective or open-system closure with explicit completion requirements
theory_health.3: internally usable EFT or phenomenology with bounded regime
theory_health.4: healthy control in its declared regime
